remarks: Welcome to 628 Rapallo Avenue, where ocean views, inviting character, and everyday comfort come together in San Pedro’s Miraleste Pines neighborhood. High ceilings create an airy feel, while brick accents and a living room fireplace bring warmth and texture to the interior. Laminate flooring complements the home’s modern architectural style, creating a welcoming setting for quiet evenings and gatherings alike. The kitchen features a six-burner stove, dishwasher, microwave, and refrigerator, with conveniently located laundry facilities. All bedrooms are on the main level, including a primary suite with its own bathroom, offering a practical layout for comfortable daily living. Ou
